question: Why is the assisting power necessary for ritual eligibility?
premises: Without power, one lacks eligibility in ritual.
The inner noble power of awareness has an outer counterpart.
Ordinarily, ritual action depends on that outer assisting power.
inference: Ritual eligibility generally requires the presence of an assisting power corresponding to inner awareness.
plain_english: Because one without power would not be eligible for ritual, the outer counterpart of the inner noble power of awareness is ordinarily required.
